description.value: Brookside Inn is a six-suite boutique hotel nestled beside Pepin Brook Vineyard Estates in West Abbotsford, with each suite individually themed after a classic romantic film. The property is five minutes from Abbotsford International Airport and positioned near hiking, birding, and the Fraser Valley's Circle Farm Tour routes. Owners Chris and Sandi Buis prepare a complimentary continental breakfast each morning using locally sourced ingredients.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address, phone, and name exactly. All subpages were reviewed; no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, e-bike charging, tools, pump, or any cycling-specific infrastructure is present anywhere on the site. OSM's internet_access=wlan tag could not be corroborated by website text, so Wi-Fi is left null per the rules.
concerns: Website footer on /about/ and /birding/ subpages contains apparent WordPress theme demo contact info ('tel: +58 2123 456789', 'fax: +58 2123 456788', '19th Paradise Street Sitia') — this is residual theme placeholder content and does not reflect the actual business, but suggests the site has not been fully cleaned up.
No cycling-specific content or amenities mentioned anywhere on the site; cyclist suitability is entirely unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, operating boutique hotel in a cycling-relevant area, but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website; direct outreach is needed before including in the WWC directory.

wow_evidence: six-suite boutique hotel... complimentary continental breakfast each morning using locally sourced ingredients

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Six-suite themed boutique hotel w/ gourmet breakfast, ~$200-250
